description: Fictional anodized aluminum manufacturer selling to procurement and engineering buyers. Clean, technical, trustworthy. Example brand for the template system.
toneOfVoice: Precise and calm, like a senior applications engineer. No hype words (revolutionary, best-in-class, world-class).
Lead with the buyer's risk: failed inspections, color mismatch between lots, missed lead times, rework cost.
Use specs and standards by name: AAMA 611, MIL-A-8625 Type II and III, ASTM B680, coating thickness in microns, lead time in days.
Proof over promises: certifications (ISO 9001), test reports per lot, on-time delivery rate.
CTAs that fit a B2B buying process: request samples, send a drawing for a quote, download the spec sheet.
